control_families.text: input[type=text|email] name=c<Field> with placeholder equal to label; the visible label is a heading (h-level) preceding the control reading '<Label>*'; native required=true when starred.
control_families.file: a 'Upload Resume*' + hidden input[type=file]#main-attachment name=cResume accept='.pdf, .doc, .docx, .txt, .rtd, .pages'; extra anchors 'Use My Indeed Resume' / 'Apply Using LinkedIn' (OAuth import, not exercised).
control_families.phone_sms: input cPhoneNumber followed by checkbox name=smsConsent with paragraph 'By providing your phone number you agree to receive informational text messages from <Employer>...'.
control_families.salary: select name=salaryCurrency (119 currencies, default 'US Dollar ($)') + input cSalary 'Desired Salary' + select (Hourly|Weekly|Monthly|Yearly). Starred on bz-01/03.
control_families.textarea: textarea name=cSummary ('Experience Summary'), cCoverLetter ('Cover Letter'), and custom section_<ts>_question_<n> long answers.
control_families.custom_questions: name=section_<timestamp>_question_<index>; control is text, textarea, or native select with an empty first option; the question text is a preceding heading; required = native required=true (and '*').
control_families.eeo_radios: input[type=radio] name=race_ethnicity (ids race_white, race_black, race_hispanic(=Asian label!), race_indian, race_hawaiian, race_two, race_latino, race_white_no) and name=gender (gender_male, gender_female, gender_no); native required=true despite intro text 'You are requested (not required) to complete the personal data below'.
control_families.submit: button[type=submit] 'Submit Application' (bz-01) or button 'Submit Application' after 'Back'/'Continue' buttons (bz-02/03). STOP BOUNDARY.

provider_hint.for_jev: Breezy: single-page /apply form; names c<Field>; custom questions section_<ts>_question_<n> labelled by the preceding heading (full text, may include an explanatory paragraph). Required = native required or trailing '*'. Expect several long narrative textareas per employer plus salary/period/currency. EEO radios are natively required but must stay human-only. Never fill hp_7f2b. Stop at 'Submit Application'.

edge_cases: Custom-domain hosting (careers.kitbash3d.com) is byte-identical markup; detect by form[name=form] + cName/cEmail + hp_ honeypot rather than host.
Success and 'nearly done' headings are present in the DOM before submission; do not treat their presence as completion.
